drums.description: Rock drum solo and instructional track, Acoustic drum kit with a crisp snare, resonant toms, and bright cymbals, The performance features syncopated snare ghost notes, rapid double-stroke rolls, and heavy accents on the crash cymbals, The kick drum follows a varied pattern, alternating between steady quarter notes and syncopated double-time bursts, The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time, High-fidelity recording with a natural room reverb and clear separation between the kick, snare, and overheads Publish

bass.description: Hard rock bass guitar solo, The track features a heavily overdriven electric bass guitar with a thick, mid-forward growl and significant sustain, The performance utilizes aggressive fingerstyle plucking, frequent slides, and percussive ghost notes, The composition follows a blues-based minor pentatonic scale with syncopated sixteenth-note runs and rhythmic variations, The tempo is 110 BPM in 4/4 time, The recording has a dry, close-miked aesthetic with minimal room reverb, emphasizing the mechanical clack of the strings against the frets Publish
